user.title: Add Presence Replay
user.description: Pick the lights whose brightness should be recorded and replayed.

data_description.delta_days: How many days back to replay, e.g. 7 for a week ago.
data_description.jitter_seconds: Randomise each event by up to this many seconds. 0 disables jitter.
data_description.transition: Fade duration passed to light.turn_on / light.turn_off. 0 omits the parameter.
data_description.retention_days: Events older than this are pruned from the log.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Quiet period after a state change before it is recorded.
data_description.min_delta: Ignore brightness changes smaller than this (0-255).
data_description.use_snapshot: Replay the frozen snapshot (captured automatically each time the switch turns on) instead of the rolling log. Prevents feedback loops on long trips.
data_description.restore_on_stop: Return lights to their pre-simulation state when the switch turns off.

snapshot.name: Take snapshot
snapshot.description: Freeze the last delta_days of recorded events into the snapshot slot.

config_entry_id.name: Presence Replay entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Presence Replay config entry to snapshot.

clear_log.name: Clear log
clear_log.description: Permanently delete all recorded events for a Presence Replay entry.

config_entry_id.name: Presence Replay entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Presence Replay config entry to clear.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Type CLEAR to confirm you want to permanently delete the log.

export_log.name: Export log
export_log.description: Return the recorded event log as response data, for inspection from Developer Tools.
